question: Do Vietnamese fish-cake, fish-ball and fish-tofu makers already use soy isolate or other plant protein, at what share, and would two of them run a 10 to 20% fish-protein substitution trial with a sensory panel?
why_it_matters: Decides whether SLS-C1 (hybrid fish cakes) has a buyer; a yes raises market pull from 2 to 3, a no kills it
cheapest_way_to_close: Phone calls to LC Foods, Viet Sin and one leading surimi exporter; read ingredient labels of 10 chả cá and cá viên products in a supermarket
owner_org_to_ask: LC Foods; Viet Sin; DALU SURIMI; CASES; KICOIMEX

question: How large is the domestic market for surimi-based products (chả cá, cá viên, đậu hũ cá) in tonnes and value?
why_it_matters: Decides whether SLS-C1 is a domestic or an export play; no source found
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the VASEP surimi committee; check NSO industrial output series for processed fish products

question: Do Korean, Japanese or EU rules or buyer specifications set a minimum fish content for fish cakes and crab sticks, and how does the EU treat a fish-plant composite at the border?
why_it_matters: A minimum fish content above 70 to 90% would block hybrid exports; composite-product rules could add certificates
cheapest_way_to_close: Desk read of the Korean Food Code (fish paste products), Japanese kamaboko labelling rules and EU composite-product rules
owner_org_to_ask: MFDS Korea; Consumer Affairs Agency Japan; European Commission DG SANTE

question: Where are Vietnam's surimi plants, and what share of their raw material comes from trawl landings, pangasius side streams and imports?
why_it_matters: Measures how hard the 2030 capture cut and IUU rules will squeeze surimi supply, the reason for SLS-C1
cheapest_way_to_close: VASEP surimi committee; annual reports or websites of the leading exporters

question: What are farm output and farm-gate prices of grouper and Asian seabass in Vietnam?
why_it_matters: Needed before T8 names target species; a high price supports a cultivated research case
cheapest_way_to_close: Khanh Hoa provincial agriculture department data; RIA3 market notes; one retail check
owner_org_to_ask: RIA3; Khanh Hoa Department of Agriculture and Environment

question: Would Thiruvalluvar University (Asian seabass muscle lines), Pukyong National University (grouper muscle line) or James Cook University Singapore share a food-relevant line with a Vietnamese host such as Nha Trang University or RIA3?
why_it_matters: Turns RM-14 and T8 into a concrete first project; without a line there is no T8
owner_org_to_ask: Thiruvalluvar University; Pukyong National University; James Cook University Singapore; Nha Trang University

question: Does TCVN 8682:2025 (ISO 23855:2021) allow any non-fish protein in frozen surimi, and what protein and moisture does it set by grade?
why_it_matters: Confirms that a blend must be sold as a fish-paste product, not as surimi, and replaces our assumed surimi dry matter in the cost calculation
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy the standard from the national standards body or ISO
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Standards and Quality Institute; ISO
